name: smart-student-backend
description: Backend for Smart Student Performance and Skill System

scripts.start:clean: node -e "const net=require('net');const server=net.createServer();server.listen(5000,()=>{server.close();console.log('Port 5000 is free');process.exit(0)});server.on('error',()=>{console.log('Port 5000 is in use, killing process...');require('child_process').exec('for /f %i in (\"netstat -ano | findstr :5000 | findstr LISTENING\") do taskkill /PID %i /F /T',()=>{process.exit(0)})})" && npm start
scripts.start:force: powershell -Command "Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -like '*node*' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*server.js*' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2" && npm start
scripts.check-port: node -e "const net=require('net');const server=net.createServer();server.listen(5000,()=>{server.close();console.log('✅ Port 5000 is available');process.exit(0)});server.on('error',()=>{console.log('❌ Port 5000 is in use');process.exit(1)})"
scripts.kill-port: powershell -Command "try { $process = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; Stop-Process -Id $process -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host '✅ Killed process using port 5000' } catch { Write-Host 'ℹ️  No process found using port 5000' }"
scripts.restart: npm run kill-port && timeout /t 2 && npm start
